I'm going to suggest something that very few people agree with:

Sometimes, the only way out of a man is another man.

The reasons to disagree with that statement are obvious - you should spend time with yourself first, heal your own wounds, and then seek someone else. You can't expect a lasting relationship with a new man who's little more than splint for your wound. These are good reasons, too.

My counterpoint is that sometimes, you need a splint. Sometimes you need the support of someone else before you can help yourself.

Chance are you won't stay with the person once you've made the changes you need to make, and you need to be fair and to be honest with him about this. But the right guy for you now will be fine with that. If he's not, move on to somebody else.
